description: This file contains unit tests for the AuthProviderChain class in the OrangeHRM authentication module. It tests the authentication flow with different provider configurations and priorities, including mock providers.

classes.name: AuthProviderChainTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing authentication provider chain behavior in different configurations.

classes.name: DebugAuthProvider
classes.description: Mock authentication provider that always returns true for authenticate method.

classes.name: LocalAuthProvider
classes.description: Mock provider which authenticates if username equals password and username is not null.

classes.name: LDAPAuthProvider
classes.description: Mock provider that authenticates if username equals password and username is not null, similar to LocalAuthProvider.

methods.name: testAuthenticateWithOneProvider
methods.description: Tests authentication with a single provider in the chain.

methods.name: testAuthenticateWithMultipleProvidersResolvingFirstProvider
methods.description: Tests that the chain resolves correctly when the first provider authenticates successfully.

methods.name: testAuthenticateWithMultipleProvidersResolvingSecondProvider
methods.description: Tests that the chain correctly moves to the second provider when the first one fails.

methods.name: testAuthenticateWithMultipleProvidersResolvingLastProvider
methods.description: Tests that the chain reaches the last provider and authenticates successfully.

methods.name: testAddProviderWithMultipleProvidersWithSamePriority
methods.description: Tests that adding a provider with a conflicting priority throws an exception.

methods.name: testAddProvider
methods.description: Tests adding the same provider instance twice results in an exception.
